profile.headline: Java Champion | Senior Principal Software Engineer @ IBM | Boston Java Users ACM Chapter Vice Chair & board member | Open Source Contributor & enthusiast
profile.summary: Java Champion and Senior Principal Software Engineer with over 26 years of experience in designing and building Java-based solutions. Specializes in application development technologies including Quarkus and Spring Boot. Passionate about open-source software, prolific contributor to open-source projects, and an active speaker at industry events and user group meetups around the world. Published author of “Quarkus for Spring Developers” book and numerous industry articles on sites such as DZone, InfoQ, Red Hat Developer, and quarkus.io. Primary maintainer of the Quarkus Superheroes sample/reference application, created in 2021 and continually evolving. Boston Java Users ACM Chapter board member.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Making Open Source software even better for the Java ecosystem. Member of the Quarkus open-source engineering team, driving Quarkus and LangChain4j adoption as the leading Java frameworks for AI-infused application development.
- Lead the Spring-style testing compatibility working group within Quarkus, establishing a cross-team initiative to bring Spring-familiar testing patterns to Quarkus developers.
- Spearhead the Docling Java ecosystem within the wider Docling open-source project: co-created and co-maintain the docling-java library (with Java Champion Thomas Vitale), built a Quarkus extension for Docling, and collaborated with the Apache Camel team to baseline the camel-docling component on Docling Java.
- Open-source Quarkus vs. Spring performance benchmarks into the public domain, coordinating a multi-team effort across the Quarkus engineering team and the IBM performance team.
- Backport AI service observability from Quarkus LangChain4j to upstream LangChain4j, expanding observability capabilities across the Java AI ecosystem.
- Prototype continuous evaluation tooling for AI-infused Java applications, advancing the team's ability to validate AI-infused application behavior in CI/CD pipelines.
- Establish engineering collaboration with the JetBrains engineering team to drive joint Quarkus initiatives for IntelliJ IDEA.
- Co-host Quarkus Insights weekly video podcast, delivering ongoing technical education to the global Quarkus community (230+ episodes to date).
- Mentor 3 teams of computer science students at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (RPI) through the IBM Open Innovation Community and RPI Center for Open Source.
- Organize the IBM Developer Academy's OpenTech Accelerate program, mentoring IBMers to engage with and contribute to open-source projects.
- Program committee member, dev2next 2026; community reviewer for Devoxx UK & Belgium.
- Conduct customer engagements, representing IBM as a subject matter expert on Java modernization and AI integration.

positions.title: Senior Principal Developer Advocate | Senior Technical Staff Member
positions.description:
Position was moved from Red Hat to IBM.

Member of IBM developer advocacy team responsible for community engagement, messaging, and materials within cloud-native application development technologies.

- Write technical articles, blogs, social media posts, and generally drive influence within the community about upstream open-source technologies, such as Quarkus.
- Meet with IBM customers as a subject matter expert to discuss modernization and migration strategies.
- Speak and present at industry events worldwide on various software development topics.
- Contribute to various Open Source projects, including Quarkus, Wiremock, Microcks, and LangChain4J.

positions.title: Senior Solution Architect - Application Development
positions.description:
Technical specialist on the Red Hat pre-sales team in the Northeast Region, helping guide customers through their digital transformations, while becoming a trusted advisor.
• Lead technology conversations with customers centered around Red Hat’s Runtimes technologies (Spring, Quarkus, JBoss EAP/Wildfly, Red Hat Data Grid/Infinispan, Red Hat Single Sign-on/Keycloak), Integration technologies (Red Hat Fuse/Apache Camel, Red Hat 3scale, Red Hat AMQ/Apache ActiveMQ Artemis, Red Hat AMQ Streams/Apache Kafka, Change Data Capture/Debezium), Business Process Automation technologies (Red Hat Decision Manager/Drools/OptaPlanner/Kogito, Red Hat Process Automation Manager/jBPM), and Red Hat OpenShift container platform.
• Present/demonstrate on product portfolio
• Work with Account Executives on strategy within customer base
• Field technical questions/concerns/support issues around product portfolio
• Evangelize (author blog posts, assist with Red Hat User Groups, speak at community events, etc) on topics such as cloud native application development, container best practices, serverless architectures, and more
• Work with product teams to help customers get requested features into future product releases
• Present talks/workshops at industry events, such as Red Hat Summit, local Red Hat User Groups, etc

positions.title: Associate Information Officer (AIO) | Sr. Architect - Global General Insurance Technology
positions.locationName: New Hampshire | New York | North Carolina
positions.description:
Member of Global Applied Architecture group within AIG’s Commercial Insurance IT organization, providing architecture oversight globally across AIG’s Commercial lines of business. I pioneer new and emerging technology/services and determine how they may help us solve problems within our organization.
•	Standardize the DevOps toolchain across the organization.
•	Lead Architect for standardizing Artifactory repository structure (remote/local/virtual) across the SDLC & technology stacks.
•	Design/develop/deliver custom Gradle distribution for use across the organization.
•	Develop & deliver various Gradle plugins outside of the packaged distribution (Swagger documentation generation, etc).
•	Member of working group to create standards, guidelines, & best practices for RESTful service development.
•	Member of working group to create standards, guidelines, & best practices for using Pivotal Cloud Foundry & it’s associated services (SSO, Config Server, etc) within the organization.
•	Design, develop, & deliver RESTful service application framework built on Spring Boot & Spring MVC.
•	Develop & deliver on-site trainings for building cloud-native / 12 Factor applications with Spring Boot.
•	Build & deliver custom Spring Initializr application on Pivotal Cloud Foundry for generating standardized projects.
•	Establish best practices & code quality standards across the organization, including setting Sonar rules for Java, Groovy, & Kotlin.
•	Contribute standardized/generalized solutions back to Open Source communities.
positions.insights: Skills: GitHub · Java · Spring Boot · Spring Framework

positions.title: Lead Solution Architect
positions.description:
•	Design generic patterns for enterprise-level web content consumption/injection patterns using Fatwire as source systems. Implement said patterns into a shared framework API.
•	Build next generation container-neutral web application, SaaS, & web/rest service platforms based on Spring MVC & Jersey. Primary goals include ability to re-use a web application instance across channels/sites and rapid application development by development teams (close to 0-configuration).
•	Design overall architecture for building highly-personalized web experiences to our customers, involving tracking what users do on one page so that real-time decisions can be made on what to display on the next page, as well as building a generic rules engine for evaluating complicated personalization expressions.
•	Build custom Spring XML namespaces & JavaConfig annotations to support our “close to 0-configuration” model.
•	Build various Eclipse plugins for helping make developer's jobs easier based on how development is done within the organization.
•	Design/develop/deliver next generation build platform based on Gradle. Design/implement various custom plugins for delivering organization-wide custom distribution & enforcing organization’s requirements & best practices.
•	Provide consulting to various teams across the organization as needed. Contribute to design/development/testing.
•	Aid in establishing best practices & code quality standards across the organization, including setting Sonar rules for Java, Groovy, Javascript, Freemarker, & HTML/JSP.
•	Perform code & promote test driven development. Review many ongoing projects & suggesting design/implementation changes based on established best practices.
•	Develop & deliver in-person & remote trainings (overview & technical) for managers, tech leads, & developers.
•	Presented “Gradle at TIAA-CREF” at the March 2013 New England Java Users Group meeting in conjunction with Gradle, Inc.

positions.title: Referee
positions.description: Level 2 Referee focusing on both youth & adult ice hockey programs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented new requirements to the Charles River Anywhere web portal/platform. 
•	Converted Adobe Flex screens to new Javascript/SmartClient framework. 
•	Designed & developed Javascript class structures for reusable components. 
•	Designed & developed Javascript/jQuery API which allows customers to easily customize the product.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented new requirements to Putnam’s Portfolio Construction and trading application - Java Swing front-end, J2EE/EJB middle-tier, Oracle back-end. 
•	Prototyped mobile device application for Android, iPhone, iPad, & Blackberry using Sencha Touch & jQuery Mobile HTML5/Javascript frameworks. 
•	Implemented new requirements to Blackberry application. 
•	Designed and developed automated report scheduling system for print/email delivery of reports. 
•	Upgraded existing application to be Java SE 6 compliant and implement Java SE 6-specific features, including generics, concurrency utilities, and many others. 
•	Mentored junior developer(s). 
•	Integrated Oracle Coherence caching product into the Portfolio Construction application. Responsible for the overall design of the architecture and implementation. 
•	Integrated with other data warehouses and retrieve real-time data on request. 
•	Converted entire application (front & back ends) to Java 6, EJB 3.0. Also upgraded from Sun ONE Application Server 7 to Sun Java System Application Server 9, Java 1.4 to Java 6, as well as new hardware and newer versions of various 3rd party libraries that are used. 
•	Automated staging & deployment process from 14-step manual process to 2-step automated process with little to no manual intervention. 
•	Converted 7 years worth of CVS data & history into a new Subversion system without losing any history. 
•	Managed Subversion repository. 
•	Designed, developed, and managed several different components that are shared throughout numerous teams at Putnam, including an enhanced SwingWorker component, generic “data model” component, and many other pluggable Swing components. 
•	Consistently delivered projects and assignments on or ahead of schedule and budget. 
•	Interviewed and phone screened potential candidates for various software development positions within Putnam. 
•	Conducted interviews at local colleges and universities for Putnam’s College Recruitment program.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed standalone and servlet-based Java applications for the UNIX and Windows environments. 
•	Designed and developed interface for property managers to submit financial statements (balance sheets, income statements, statements of cash flows, low income housing reports) to their financial institution. 
•	Designed and developed interface for institutional investors to receive online reports regarding the funds that they are invested in. 
•	Implemented and interfaced with RealNetworks RealMedia Server and Microsoft Windows Media Server. 
•	Designed and modeled database schemas for new projects using UML and Rational Rose/Rational XDE. 
•	Functioned as Release Engineer, including CVS repository setup, branching, and merging of code and documentation. 
•	Lead developer/architect for all projects for one of Inforonics’ biggest and longest-term clients. 
•	Designed and architected a generic XML-based data conversion routine to allow for multiple syndication partners to access that same data. 
•	Used various open-source components such as Cocoon and FOP (part of the Apache Project) in conjunction with Java standalone programs to automate reporting for usage analysis. 
•	Architected, designed, and modeled new requirements using UML, including modeling of database schemas, using Rational Rose. 
•	Developed Java standalone application for indexing distributed website which indexes 5000 news releases per day. 
•	Responsible for time estimates on new projects for the development team for which I was a part of. 
•	Managed resources allocated by project managers and report back status.

volunteerExperiences.description: Help with FIRST New Hampshire events (robot inspector, referee).
